raw_response:
Answer: A
Reason: Broncholithiasis is characterized by the erosion of a calcified lymph node into the bronchial lumen, causing obstruction; the combination of a calcified nodule and associated segmental atelectasis (visible in the left lower lobe on the provided CT) strongly supports this diagnosis over non-obstructive calcifications or soft tissue masses.
